Create MR1 Data Package

Source: R/createDataPackage.R
createDataPackage.Rd

createDataPackage() compiles data from extractDbData() into a standardised MR1 data package for one radar campaign, following the Frictionless Data Package standard. Time range, pulse type, rotation, echo class, class probability, altitude and echo validator filters are applied with filterProtocolData() and filterEchoData().

The package contains five tabular resources: echo_data, protocol_data, blind_times, sunrise_sunset and site_data. Each resource has a Table Schema with field types, descriptions, units, and primary and foreign keys. echo_data contains all echo columns, except those that are obsolete or redundant: mtr_factor_old, statistical_classification_old, classification_id and sphere_dia (old classification, outdated since BirdScan v1.6), feature15.polRatio and feature16.absPolarisation (outdated since BirdScan v1.6), feature3.speed (superseded by feature37.speed), time_string (same as time_stamp_originTZ), and time_bin and altitude_bin (refer to radar database tables that are not part of the package). The package-level metadata (title, description, owner, licence, embargo, contributors with ORCID and DataCite roles, related identifiers, suggested citation) are read from metadata. Spatial and temporal coverage, the applied filters and the provenance (database, birdscanR and classifier versions) are added automatically.

When outputDirPath is provided, the package is written to outputDirPath/<campaignID>/ as datapackage.json plus one compressed CSV file per resource, ready for a Zenodo deposit.

Usage

createDataPackage(
  dbExtract,
  metadata,
  manualBlindTimes = NULL,
  dbName = NULL,
  pulseTypeSelection = NULL,
  rotationSelection = NULL,
  timeRangeTargetTZ = NULL,
  classSelection = NULL,
  classProbCutOff = NULL,
  altitudeRange = NULL,
  echoValidator = FALSE,
  outputDirPath = NULL,
  saveAsRDS = FALSE
)

Arguments

dbExtract

named list with the database tables extracted by extractDbData().

metadata

path to a YAML file, or a named list with the same structure, with the package-level metadata. Use createDataPackageMetadataTemplate() to get a template.

manualBlindTimes

data frame with the manual blind times created by loadManualBlindTimes(), or NULL (default) if there are none. They are merged with the radar blind times by mergeVisibilityAndManualBlindTimes(). Only blind times that overlap a selected measurement period (protocol) are included in the package.

dbName

Name of the database. Stored in the package provenance. Default is NULL.

pulseTypeSelection

character vector with the pulse types which should be included in the subset. Options: S, M, L, i.e. short-, medium-, long-pulse, respectively. Default is NULL: no filtering applied based on pulseType.

rotationSelection

numeric vector to select the operation modes with and/or without antenna rotation. Options: 0, 1. (0 = no rotation, 1 = rotation). Default is NULL: no filtering applied based on rotation mode.

timeRangeTargetTZ

Character vector of length 2, with start and end of time range, formatted as "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", in the target time zone, or a POSIXct vector of length 2. Echoes outside the time range will be excluded. Default is NULL: the full time range of the echo data is used.

classSelection

character string vector with the classes that should be included. Default is NULL: all classes are included.

classProbCutOff

numeric cutoff value for class probabilities. Echoes with a lower class probability will be excluded. Default is NULL: no cutoff applied.

altitudeRange

numeric vector of length 2 with start and end of the altitude range in metres a.g.l. Echoes outside the altitude range will be excluded. Default is NULL: no altitude filtering applied.

echoValidator

logical. If set to FALSE (default), no additional filter is applied; if set to TRUE, echoes labelled by the echo validator as "non-bio scatterer" will be excluded.

outputDirPath

Directory where the data package is written, in a subdirectory named after the campaignID in metadata. If NULL (default), no files are written.

saveAsRDS

logical. If TRUE and outputDirPath is provided, the returned data package object is also saved as <campaignID>.rds in outputDirPath. Default is FALSE.

Value

A Frictionless Data Package object (class mr1dp and datapackage), i.e. a list with the package-level metadata and the resources echo_data, protocol_data, blind_times, sunrise_sunset and site_data. Read a resource as a data frame with frictionless::read_resource().

See also

Other write file functions: compileData(), createDataPackageMetadataTemplate(), saveMTR(), savePlotToFile(), uploadDataPackageToZenodo(), validateDataPackage()

Author

Baptiste Schmid, Fabian Hertner, Birgen Haest

Examples

# \donttest{
# Load example data
# ===========================================================================
dbData = readRDS(system.file("extdata",
  "CH_Sempach_2024_SEP24_25_DataExtract.rds",
  package = "birdscanR"
))
dbName = "CH_Sempach_2024_SEP24_25"
timeRangeTargetTZ = c("2024-09-24 00:00", "2024-09-25 23:59")
mainOutputDir = tempdir()

# Set manual blind times to NULL (no manual blind times)
# ===========================================================================
cManualBlindTimes = NULL

# Write the package metadata template (fill it in for a real campaign)
# ===========================================================================
metadataFile = file.path(mainOutputDir, "CH_Sempach_2024_metadata.yaml")
createDataPackageMetadataTemplate(filePath = metadataFile, overwrite = TRUE)

# Create MR1 data package
# ===========================================================================
dataPackage = createDataPackage(
  dbExtract          = dbData,
  metadata           = metadataFile,
  manualBlindTimes   = cManualBlindTimes,
  dbName             = dbName,
  timeRangeTargetTZ  = timeRangeTargetTZ,
  pulseTypeSelection = "S",
  outputDirPath      = mainOutputDir
)

# Read a resource of the data package
# ===========================================================================
echoData = frictionless::read_resource(dataPackage, "echo_data")
# }
